blocks.html: Everyone is invited to join in the celebration of Filipino Artistry as Robinsons Galleria opens the “Siklab ng Sining” exhibit on September 29 at 3pm in the mall’s main hallway at Level 2. In cooperation with The Mandaluyong Artists League and Creative Hands Art Workshop, shoppers can enjoy various creations as the mall becomes surrounded by the beauty of contemporary art from renowned Filipino artists such as Ral Arrogante, Oyi Madrilejos, Nonilon Alipio, Joel Tabuena, Jet Bernal, Mayrose Gisbert, Lourdes Delgado, Mitz Esguerra, Kathy Garrido, Chiqui Lizada, Audrey Sin, Kimmy Esguerra, Antonio Gisbert, Jr., Rudy Lunod, Gari Carreon, Angela Amor, Karina Yu, Angel Go, Andres Katigbak, Tyler Borja, Rhea Fernandez, Mae Anicieto, Bee Paterno, Jude Saez, Jhomer Agulay, Marky Delos Reyes and Josh Veve. A special Art Workshop for kids will also be held at Robinsons Galleria on September 30, October 1 and October 6 at 3 p.m. During this free workshop, the kids can hone their skills and creativity in using the different media of art such as Oil Pastels, Poster Color and Sculpturing while being taught by Master Artists. The “Siklab ng Sining” exhibit will be on display from September 29 until October 6.
